page.layout: One printed block only: a bookplate with a framed text at the top, an engraved coat of arms with a motto around it in the centre, a handwritten signature and a handwritten section note below. No printed text in the margins. The handwriting is not printed text and is left out.

main_text.l: Presented by HON. D. BETHUNE DUFFIELD.
From Library of Rev. Geo. Duffield, D.D.

page.notes: Bookplate with an engraved coat of arms: a shield with three birds (two above, one below) and a white chevron, a bird perched on the helm, and the mottos above and below. Manuscript signature "Geo Duffield" and handwritten "Section" with "I°" below are not printed text and are left out. Black marks and stains at the left edge are damage, not text.
